title: Cancer Free Since 2011 – Featured Healing Story
content: Cancer Free Since 2011 – Featured Healing StoryRadical Remission ProjectJan 9, 20152 min readUpdated: Nov 9, 2023Bailey O’Brien is a Radical Remission survivor of stage 4 melanoma skin cancer. Diagnosed at the early age of 21, she first tried conventional medicine to its fullest, but when her cancer returned, she decided to try other healing methods. Today, she currently has no evidence of cancer.Here is her story in her own words:Two weeks after supposedly getting rid of stage 3 melanoma in my head/neck area by surgery and radiation, I discovered a suspicious bump under my chin. My doctor performed a biopsy and determined that it was melanoma, so then she ordered a CT scan to see if it was anywhere else in my body. The scan revealed 7 tumors in total, in my neck, lung and spine. I did not want to pursue conventional treatments because I already tried that route and I did not want to destroy my body with toxins.After finding 7 tumors and being diagnosed with stage 4 melanoma, I decided to stand up for my health, go with my gut (against my doctor’s orders) and pursue alternative treatments. I went to a hospital in Mexico where I received the Coley Fluid (http://mbvax.com/index.php), started a modified version of the Gerson therapy (including a strict diet and use of coffee enemas), and received laetrile (vitamin B17), high dose vitamin C infusions, and vitamin supplements. I prayed for a miracle, and 6 weeks after starting the regimen, a PET scan revealed that all 7 tumors had gone away![Regarding what may cause cancer]: Toxins in our food, water and environment, stress (which suppresses the immune system), poor attitude, poor diet, lack of nutrients, too much sun exposure/sunburn.For more information, please visit Bailey’s website at www.baileyobrien.com.EDITOR'S NOTE: As of October 2020, Bailey is well and thriving post diagnosis.Did you know that The Radical Remission Project puts out a monthly newsletter with even more stories of healing as well as upcoming events and the latest news?! Sign up HERE!Finally, feel free to leave a COMMENT below. We love hearing from you!241241 views00 commentsPost not marked as liked

analysis.case_summary: At age 21, Bailey O’Brien was diagnosed with recurrent melanoma that progressed to stage 4 with 7 tumors in the neck, lung, and spine after prior surgery and radiation for stage 3 disease. After refusing further conventional treatment, she pursued an alternative regimen (Coley Fluid, modified Gerson therapy with strict diet and coffee enemas, laetrile, high-dose vitamin C, supplements) and reported that a PET scan 6 weeks later showed all tumors had disappeared; she is described as cancer-free since 2011 and well as of Oct 2020.
